reason: The cited evidence (E1) reports a ligand-effect downshift of the Pt d-band center in a Pt-containing high-entropy alloy, but it does not involve Pt/Cu core–shell nanoparticles, ethanol oxidation, or any systematic variation of shell thickness. Therefore, none of the key premises specific to the Pt/Cu system and ethanol oxidation are supported by the provided prior evidence.
premises: Thinner Pt shells on Cu cores enhance electronic coupling and downshift the Pt d-band center.
